children: TOTALENERGIES TAKES DECISIVE STEPS TOWARDS FINAL INVESTMENT DECISION ON PAPUA LNG
TRANSFERRING OPERATORSHIP TO EXXONMOBIL, OPERATOR OF PNG LNG
WILL SELL A 9.1% INTEREST (POST BACK-IN OF KUMUL PETROLEUM) IN PROJECT TO ITS PAPUA LNG PARTNERS
WILL RETAIN A 20% INTEREST IN PROJECT, WHILE MAINTAINING ITS LNG OFFTAKE SHARE OF PROJECT.
ESTABLISHMENT OF A JOINT VENTURE FOR THE MARKETING OF LNG
THE JOINT VENTURE WILL MARKET 2.4 MT/YEAR OF LNG OUT OF PAPUA LNG'S TOTAL PRODUCTION OF 5.6 MT/YEAR
